publicOption.name: imageGps
publicOption.description: Include GPS latitude and longitude from image EXIF metadata.
publicOption.metadataFalseBehavior: Suppress all EXIF-derived fields, including DateTimeOriginal, Orientation, Make, Model, and GPS, regardless of imageGps.

metadataMapping.dimensions: metadata.custom pairs image.width and image.height; image block width and height remain available
metadataMapping.DateTimeOriginal: metadata.created as a timezone-free ISO local timestamp
metadataMapping.GPSLatitude: metadata.custom pair image.gps.latitude when imageGps is true
metadataMapping.GPSLongitude: metadata.custom pair image.gps.longitude when imageGps is true

readerIntegration: Deferred until the core reader registry and shared ExtractOptions are available; this file does not change the public API.
